ce_bugs.text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:92 — The attendee rows are committed before the calendar update, so a calendar failure leaves guests persisted but unsynced and a retry rejects them as existing.

packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:52 — Any authenticated attendee can add arbitrary email addresses to a booking and receive its calendar/video details without organizer approval.

mrv_findings.text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:168 — `await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests);` — P1 (100): notifications use the unfiltered request rather than `uniqueGuests`, so already-attending or blacklisted addresses receive new-attendee/scheduled email despite not being added.

packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:22 — `export const addGuestsHandler = async ({ ctx, input }: AddGuestsOptions) => {` — P1 (100): this new booking mutation/calendar/notification flow has no corresponding test change, leaving authorization, filtering, persistence, calendar sync, and email behavior unverified.
